question: Refer to the exhibits. ESXi-Server is associated to the blade server. A VLAN is added to Trunk-A. The VLAN is missing on the vNIC of ESXi-Server. Which action should be taken to add the VLAN to the vNIC?
context:
Exhibit 1: Service Template ESXi-Server (updating template) - vNIC template list includes Trunk-A.
Exhibit 2: vNIC Template Trunk-A - Template Type: Initial Template.
options: Change the template type of Trunk-A to an updating template.
Remove the VLAN from the Trunk-A template and add the VLAN again.
Change the template type of ESXi-Server to an updating template.
Remove both templates and recreate them as updating templates.
theory: A vNIC template's Template Type controls propagation: an 'Initial Template' only pushes its settings to the vNICs that inherit from it at the moment they are created, while an 'Updating Template' keeps every inheriting vNIC in sync with future changes automatically. Because Trunk-A is an Initial Template, adding a new VLAN to it afterward does not retroactively update vNICs already built from it (including the one used by ESXi-Server), so the fix is to change Trunk-A's template type to Updating so the new VLAN (and future changes) propagate to associated vNICs. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 12 — Cisco UCS Network Management, vNIC Templates)
